name: August Pfluger
stance: Leads AI-security research legislation — DHS-run competitions funding interpretability and adversarial robustness — framed as staying ahead of adversaries manipulating AI systems.

statements.text: Introduced the Reliable Artificial Intelligence Research Act, funding DHS research competitions on AI interpretability and adversarial robustness; the House companion to a Banks-Hassan Senate bill.
The Reliable Artificial Intelligence Research Act puts American ingenuity to work on making AI more transparent, more predictable, and more resistant to attacks
Adversaries are already looking for ways to manipulate these systems, and we must stay ahead of them

review.note: added October 2026 from pfluger.house.gov primary sources; quotes verified verbatim
